record.question: The President of India is elected by an Electoral College consisting of
options: Members of Parliament and State Legislatures
Elected members of Parliament and State Legislature
Elected members of Parliament and State Legislative Assemblies
Elected members of Lok Sabha and members of Rajya Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies
record.explanation: The President of India is elected by an electoral college comprising members of both houses of Parliament and elected members of state legislatures.
